error.bad_compose: Could not read the compose file
error.no_plugin_dir: Could not locate the plugin directory
error.no_agent: pkexec never answered — no polkit authentication agent is running
error.rdp_failed: Could not launch the RDP session
error.web_failed: Could not open the web console
error.connect_timeout: Windows did not answer RDP in time

compose_file.label: Compose file
compose_file.description: Path to the dockurr/windows docker-compose.yml. Ports, credentials and VM sizing are all read from it.

refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_interval.description: How often to probe the VM. The probe needs no privileges and costs about 40 ms.

rdp_command.label: RDP command
rdp_command.description: Leave empty to use the bundled bin/windows-rdp launcher.

auto_connect.label: Start the VM when connecting
auto_connect.description: Connect starts the container if it is off, then opens RDP once Windows answers.
